group.name: Which werewolf setup do you use? (pick one)

plugin.name: Growl user (recommended for Nolvus users)
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use Growl - Werebeasts of Skyrim. Recommended for Nolvus users.
Werewolves get the TWO body and heads. Growl keeps its gameplay. This installs OStim_Beast_Form_Merged.esp and OStim_Beast_Form_Merged_TWO_Patch.esp, the same plugins as Merged 0.6 + the Merged TWO Patch 0.1, so a save that already uses them keeps working.
Needs: Growl, JS Emissive Eyes SE, TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul 4.1 (Core, with its Growl patch), Monster Facial Animation (MonsterLipSync1.esp).
Growl - Werebeasts of Skyrim: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/31245

plugin.name: TWO user (no Growl)
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul 4.1 and do NOT use Growl.
This installs OStim_Beast_Form_TWO.esp, the same plugin as OStim Beast Form - TWO Edition 0.2, so a save that already uses it keeps working. Never enable it together with OStim_Beast_Form_Merged.esp.
Needs: TWO 4.1 (Core), Monster Facial Animation (MonsterLipSync1.esp).
TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul: https://www.loverslab.com/topic/159911-two-total-werewolf-overhaul/

plugin.name: No
plugin.description:
Pick No if you do not use SOFTBODY (GT - Softbody). That includes UNP users, and CBBE or UBE users who don't run softbody.
Nothing softbody-related is installed. During scenes, male werewolves get TWO's own hard canine cock, which comes with TWO's Core files, so there is nothing extra to install.

plugin.name: Yes
plugin.description:
Pick Yes only if SOFTBODY (GT - Softbody) by Goutou is installed and working.
Male werewolves wear TWO's own hard canine in scenes (same look as softbody No), with a collision setup that GT Softbody bodies react to. Female werewolves get a softbody-ready copy of TWO's female body: the same body, textures and SMP, plus a stretchable vaginal canal with its own collision, so a cock with SMP collision (TWO's canine or a GT Softbody male) can push it open. Not tested in game yet.
These are edited copies of TWO's meshes, installed in this mod's own folder. TWO's own files are not overwritten. No GT Softbody files are shipped any more.
Yes also installs one OCum script, Scripts/OCumMaleScript.pex: my OCum + Tull/Liquid + GT Softbody merged script patch (the same script as OCum-Tull-Liquid-Softbody-Patch v1.0 on GitHub, used in game by the author). It replaces OCum Ascended 4.1.1's OCumMaleScript and adds GT Softbody's two OCum fixes, Tull Animated Creampie / Liquid Pack v2 support and the Scene Change Fix. Without Tull or Liquid Pack it falls back cleanly to OCum's own creampie meshes. If you ticked GT Softbody's "OCum" patch, this mod's copy must win: keep this mod BELOW GT - Softbody (and below the OCum Tull/Liquid add-on and its Scene Change Fix) in MO2's left pane. If you already use the separate patch, you can disable it (same script).
SOFTBODY (GT - Softbody): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/152103

plugin.name: Hermaphrodite patch (Fruta)
plugin.description:
Optional. Only for TWO Extras' herm / urta player werewolf (TWO Extras' "Toggle Herm Werewolf" spell).
OStim then treats your herm or urta werewolf as having a penis as well as a vagina and breasts, and it gets the aroused cock and the Beast Load climax. It installs the right files for whichever setup you picked on the first page.
Needs TWO Extras (WerewolvesExtras.esp), and TWO's WerewolvesExtrasGrowl.esp if you use Growl.
I am not going to test this myself. If you use TWO's herm or urta werewolf, please test it and report any problems in the support section of the OStim Beast Form Merged page on LoversLab.

plugin.name: I have read and understand
plugin.description:
I have read every option in this installer and didn't just click through. If I picked the wrong options, the mod won't work. This mod uses the TWO body made by Frosferes, at the LoversLab community's request. Frosferes is okay with patches but I will not repackage any files he made that I did not have to patch. So non-softbody female bodies and all Male bodies are still dependant on his TWO bodies. Anyone is free to make their own patches, hubs and mods based on this one.
Known incompatibilities (as of this release): - Diverse Werewolves Collection SE by opusGlass (https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/7009): with it installed, the camera locks to the sides. Leave it off with this mod. - TWO's TWO_SkinSwapper.dll (v0.2.1, part of TWO Extras) by Frosferes (https://www.loverslab.com/topic/159911-two-total-werewolf-overhaul/): it does not load on Skyrim SE 1.7.99 / 1.7.104 or newer, because it doesn't support the new Address Library format. TWO's gender / herm skin spells then have no effect. This is a limit of TWO's DLL and the game version, not a bug in this mod. This mod's Hermaphrodite option doesn't use that DLL, but TWO's herm / urta body is swapped in by it, so on those game versions use 1.6.1170 (or GOG 1.6.1179) for the herm body until TWO's DLL is updated.
Source code: https://github.com/Coronerra/OStim-Beast-Form-Merged
